text: Ko Annabiijo on (yo o his) ɓuri hanndude e gomɗimɓe ɓen diini ko'e maɓɓe, ɗum non ko e kala ko o noddi ɓe e mu'un, hay si tawii ko ko lurri ɗum ɓe faalanoo. Suddiiɓe makko ɓen, ko neeniraaɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen fow, hino harmani ɓe resugol gooto e ɓen, ɓaawo faatagol Annabiijo on. Awa kadi, joomiraaɓe enɗamaaji ɓen, ko ɓen ɓuri hanndude e gedal ndonu ka ñaawoore Alla, diini gomɗimɓe ɓen e feruɓe fii Alla ɓen ronindiraynoo- ɓe fewndo lislaamu layaynoo, kono nden ñaawoo- re montaa, si wanaa hara onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, on waɗan weliiɓe mon ɓe ronataa ɓen moƴƴere, immorde e wasiyee mo accanton ɓe, haray no newanii on. Nden ñaawoore wonii winndaande ka Alluwa reenaangal, hino waɗɗii gollitirgol nde.
